name: CTG Export Timezone for Windows
description: Apple Shortcuts recipe (text instructions). Import manually — not a binary .shortcut file.
author: Hacker Planet LLC
notes: Windows cannot read live iPhone GPS. This Shortcut writes timezone JSON for CTG daily 6 AM alerts.
Do not commit real coordinates or phone numbers to git.
Sync output to PC: iCloud Drive, OneDrive, or email yourself and save to Backups\iphone-location\timezone.json

trigger_options.reason: Refresh timezone before 6 AM Windows hourly check
Update IANA timezone when crossing regions

shortcut_steps.comment: Skip if you only need timezone, not coords
Prefer IANA id if Shortcuts exposes it; else map known places manually

variables.TIMEZONE_IANA_HERE: Replace with America/New_York or detected zone

alternative_delivery.subject: CTG timezone export
alternative_delivery.body: Attach timezone.json; save to Backups\iphone-location\ on Windows

steps: Create timezone.json with timezone and updated fields
